name: BSCP
levelNote: Four-hour proctored practical against two applications, each needing a foothold, privilege escalation to admin and data exfiltration — all six stages must be completed to pass, which is an unusually unforgiving bar for a short exam. Tool-coupled rather than vendor-neutral: it requires a Burp Suite Professional licence, though what it tests is web security skill rather than product administration. Score weights the required training as well as the exam: the Web Security Academy is free, self-paced and very large, comparable in substance to an intermediate course. Exam-only score 58, +7 for the training.

cost.note: Per attempt. A Burp Suite Professional subscription is required to sit it, which is a separate annual cost.
